name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you show compassion and devotion to the Light by caring for the vulnerable and offering charity in Stormwind.
Stephanie Turner sews shirts and pants for the orphaned children with bolts of linen cloth.
War orphans in Stormwind show the human cost of recent Scourge attacks across the northern Alliance realms.

faq.answer: Stephanie Turner lives in Stormwind and cares for children orphaned by the Scourge. She works to feed, clothe, and shelter them, with help from charity and her husband John.
Stephanie needs linen cloth to sew shirts and pants for the orphaned children. With food and shelter to manage, she has little time to gather materials herself.
faq.q: Why does Stephanie Turner need linen cloth?

faq.answer: John is Stephanie Turner's husband. He travels from Stormwind to gather supplies, going as far as Ironforge, though he dislikes being away from his family.
faq.q: Who is John and where has he gone?

aliases: why are there orphans in stormwind
faq.answer: Most of the children in Stephanie's care lost their families in Scourge attacks across the northern kingdoms over the past decade. Refugees and survivors brought many of them south to Stormwind.
faq.q: Why are there so many orphaned children in Stormwind?

aliases: why is this a paladin quest
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity tests an aspiring paladin's virtues, especially charity and compassion. Giving basic supplies to a caretaker shows a servant of the Light will protect the humble as well as face monsters.
faq.q: How does helping Stephanie relate to the Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: Stephanie says this year has felt rougher than past years, as if something in the air signals a great change. She cannot say what it is.
faq.q: What does Stephanie mean about 'something in the air'?

sections.body: Stephanie Turner cares for children whose families were lost to the Scourge in the northern lands over the last decade. Her husband John is away gathering supplies. So Stephanie must keep the children fed, warm, and sheltered while finding time to make them clothes.
sections.title: The Orphans of War

sections.body: An aspiring paladin proves compassion by bringing linen cloth to Stephanie. With the cloth, she can sew shirts and pants for the children while tending to their food and shelter. Such humble aid shows how the Light's protectors guard the weak.
sections.title: A Trial of Compassion

sections.body: Stephanie says this year has grown harsher. John must make long, difficult journeys as far as Ironforge to gather supplies. Even within Stormwind's high stone walls, the pain of recent tragedies in the north is still felt.
sections.title: Strains on the Capital

summary: Stephanie Turner in Stormwind needs help clothing children orphaned by the Scourge. Her husband John is gathering supplies as an aspiring paladin brings linen cloth to her home.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
